name: relai-progress
description: RelAI progress for Claude Code (early access mods): a card above the prompt with how far the work of the session is — the stage in progress of the active plan (the boxes of its prompt), a /relai-crew run, or work outside a plan said in words — and /relai-agents, a pane of the session's subagents: running and finished, model, context and cost from relai-panel's measurements. Deterministic: reads files, calls no model. Based on savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT, see LICENSE-savvy-progress). Silent outside RelAI projects.
